Warm highlights, soft rich shadows, elegant restrained colour grade, realistic scale and materials, a sense of arriving somewhere peaceful. No humans, no faces, no body parts, no text, no logos, no screens or electronics, no candles, no mist, no floating objects, no magical particles. Keep massage table and room physically plausible. Silent.
